scope_note: Second-pass public-evidence audit for Expedient's adaptive reuse of the pre-existing data-center building at 4777 W Ironwood Drive. The review searched Franklin planning, agenda, assessment, permit, water and sewer materials; Milwaukee County tax and deed-record access points; Wisconsin DOR, WEDC, DFI and PSC records; operator press, specification, career, ESG and community pages; lease, financing, carrier and vendor disclosures; and archived official pages for 2007-2026. Opening-day and current operator specifications remain separate dated snapshots because the reported area and capacity changed. The county portal now establishes a 2021-2025 parcel-tax principal series, but not Expedient's incidence under the lease. The 2022 ownership transfer, assessments, estimated permit values, tax payments and hiring plan remain non-additive. No source was found for actual construction outlays, realized site employment or payroll, local procurement, Milwaukee-area community transfers, metered resources, project-attributable public costs or a fiscal net.

sources.title: Milwaukee Franklin Data Center specification sheet
sources.notes: The current operator sheet identifies 4777 W Ironwood Drive and reports 27,000 square feet of data-center space, 10,000 square feet of raised floor, 1.6 MW of critical IT load, 3.0 MW of total generator capacity, two auto-cutover diesel generators, and multiple cooling systems. Only the whole-building area and critical-load specifications are normalized here. They are capacity descriptors, not utilization, annual electricity, construction spending, investment, employment, or audited environmental performance.

project_updates.title: Construction audit — permits remain estimated administrative values
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Franklin assessor/property record, Inspection Services forms, Plan Commission and Common Council agendas/minutes, and archived city PDFs. Queries covered Expedient, MKE1, RagingWire, NTT, H-D Franklin, RDC-4777 Ironwood Drive LLC, 4777 W Ironwood, parcel 930-1001-000, PB22-0043, PB25-0303 and PM25-0174 for 2007-2026. The public record supports estimated permit values of $27,000, $580,190 and $250,132, but no invoice, contract, completion expenditure, equipment split, contractor payment, worker hour or payroll. PM25-0174 may overlap PB25-0303. A bounded PB25-0303-only construction-eligible allocation remains as a last-resort scope sensitivity; transferred job-year and local-purchase syntheses were removed rather than presented as Franklin activity.
project_updates.project_description: Expedient MKE1 is a colocation data center operated by Expedient at 4777 W Ironwood Drive in Franklin, Milwaukee County, Wisconsin. This project account covers the single adaptive-reuse facility and its parcel, not Expedient's wider regional portfolio, and keeps the October 2021 opening snapshot separate from later current specifications. Public records trace the pre-existing building, leased operation, 2022 ownership transfer, and subsequent facility permits.

project_updates.title: Operations audit — capacity is observed, realized Franklin employment is not
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Expedient's October 20, 2021 opening release, current MKE1/IRN specification and knowledge-base pages, 2021-2026 press archives, ESG pages and current careers index. Queries used Expedient, MKE1, IRN, Milwaukee, Franklin, 4777 Ironwood, jobs, payroll and employees. Dated facility area and critical-load specifications are retained. The 2021 plan to hire twelve remains a forecast. The current careers page showed one Milwaukee-market Regional Account Executive vacancy, not a filled MKE1 operations job. No site FTE, payroll, wage, occupied rack, revenue or operating-expense observation was found.

project_updates.title: Fiscal audit — five parcel-tax principals verified; no listed state data-center exemption
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Milwaukee County Treasurer parcel account 9301001000, bills 289047, 314923, 353779, 366879 and 380021 for tax years 2021-2025; Franklin assessment rolls; Wisconsin DOR qualified-data-center guidance and certified-center list; WEDC program and transparency pages; and DFI entity search for the parcel owner. The five principal amounts are normalized separately from interest and penalties. DOR's list current through October 31, 2025 contains four certified projects and no Expedient, MKE1, Franklin site or RDC-4777 entity. No personal-property tax, sales-tax benefit, state award, operator reimbursement or same-scope net fiscal result was found.

project_updates.title: Community audit — no Milwaukee or Franklin transfer was disclosed
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Expedient press archives, current ESG/community pages, MKE Tech Hub references and searches for Milwaukee/Franklin donation, grant, volunteer, school, nonprofit and recipient disclosures from 2020-2026. A $100,000 national Feeding America donation predates the MKE1 opening and its named recipient list excludes Milwaukee and Franklin; it is not allocated here. Current pages describe volunteering and school partnerships only in general terms. No MKE1 recipient, cash amount, in-kind value or volunteer-hour quantity was found, so the prior induced-household-output synthesis was removed and no community benefit is inferred.

project_updates.title: Investment audit — property transfer and lease terms remain distinct from new capital formation
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: archived Franklin Resolution 2012-6791 and CSM 8452 parcel history; Milwaukee County assessment, tax and Register of Deeds access pages; Wisconsin DFI; StratCap's August 10, 2022 buyer release; SEC searches; and contemporaneous local reporting. Queries used 4777 W Ironwood, tax key 930-1001-000, RDC-4777 Ironwood Drive LLC, Expedient, RagingWire, NTT and H-D Franklin for 2007-2026. The buyer release confirms a fully leased triple-net property with about fifteen years remaining, 2.5% escalators and renewal options, while only the secondary report supplies the $9.46 million price. No deed instrument, mortgage amount, rent, Expedient tenant-improvement cost, IT-equipment investment or locally retained capital was public.

project_updates.title: Public-cost audit — zero parcel special assessment is not zero service cost
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: the 2025 county tax account's special-assessment and special-charge rows; Franklin Common Council/Plan Commission archives and water/sewer permit materials; Milwaukee County budgets and deed access; and PSC utility-construction and water-regulation guidance for 2021-2026. Searches used the address, parcel, operator and owner names. The 2025 parcel page reports $0 special assessments and $0 special charges, but that does not measure police, fire, road, administrative, utility or financing cost. No project-attributable public expenditure was found. Only the exact tax-equal cost threshold is retained; no actual cost or fiscal net is asserted.

project_updates.title: Resource audit — company goals do not supply MKE1 meter data
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Expedient's 2022 GRESB release, 2025 ESG/sustainability and objective pages, current MKE1 specification, PSC docket and guidance pages, We Energies data-center and tariff pages, and Franklin water/sewer materials. Queries covered Expedient, MKE1, 4777 Ironwood, electricity, PUE, water, wastewater, emissions, renewable energy and meter for 2021-2026. The operator reports a 1.6 MW critical-load capacity and company-wide monitoring and renewable goals, but no MKE1 utilization, PUE, kWh, peak demand, water, sewer, emissions or renewable share. PSC states it does not track individual-business water use. The capacity-based utilization/PUE range is retained only as a last-resort engineering sensitivity and not as observed consumption.

project_updates.title: Supplier audit — one carrier relationship is identifiable, procurement value is not
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Franklin permit/property records for contractor fields; Expedient MKE1 specifications and technology-partner pages; carrier-location directories; acquisition materials; and searches for procurement, vendor, supplier, contract and payment disclosures from 2021-2026. The current operator page reports four on-net carriers and Cogent independently lists MKE1 at 4777 Ironwood, but public sources disclose no price, payment, contractor identity for the cited permits, supplier geography or Milwaukee County retained share. The local-construction-spend and operating-supplier-output syntheses were removed.
